assets.prompt:
The words “Ear Trainer” as a hand-lettered logo: “Ear” in an elegant high-contrast serif with a soft italic swash, “Trainer” in flowing italic script, both in polished brass-gold with an ivory highlight and a subtle warm glow. A small stylised ear whose curve becomes a treble clef sits beside the word “Ear”, and three piano keys (ivory, ebony, ivory) underline the lettering. Clean silhouette on a fully transparent background, centred, no other text.
Use case: logo-brand. Generate a wide 5:2 composition, transparent background. Exact lettering must read Ear Trainer.
assets.revision_prompt: Edit this Ear Trainer logo. Keep the exact Ear Trainer lettering, ear/treble-clef motif, brass-gold finish, ivory highlights, swashes, composition, and transparent background unchanged. Replace the three ivory-ebony-ivory keys under the lettering with three equal ivory white keys, aligned neatly in parallel. No black piano key. The keys should be ivory inside with thin brass edges. Keep the lettering clearly legible at 300px wide. No added text.
